text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking down the hallway after school...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh...
Paka Petit... in, in my racing silks... um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I really... can't do this~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What on earth...?
choice_data_list: Was that voice just now... Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you.
...Y-Yeah, it's Rice.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: She was all fidgety and squirming. Just when I thought her stomach was hurting, she bolted off in a flash...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wonder what that was about?
She was saying something about racing silks, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace tilted her head in confusion.
Wondering what could possibly be the matter with Rice Shower, I decided to go after her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I knew it was no good.
Not like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I find Rice Shower slumped with her shoulders drooping
in a corner of the cafeteria.
On the table in front of her is...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Hyaaaa!? D-Dear brother!?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Hyaaaa!? D-Dear sister!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, it seems different from what's sold in stores...
Could this possibly be...
choice_data_list: Did you make this, Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can tell it's handmade after all, huh.
That it's not the real deal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Glancing sideways at the doll, Rice Shower let out a deep sigh and began explaining the situation.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay... for Rice to have
this Paka Petit...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
You said you wanted to line a few up in your room, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mine was too far in the back so I couldn't reach it,
but I was able to get that one for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much.
But um... what should Rice give you in return...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't worry about it!
I did it because I wanted to, and if it made you happy, that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because the fact that you remembered,
and gave me a present,
made me so incredibly happy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice tried to win Ace-san's Paka Puchi too,
but she failed. And so...
choice_data_list: You made this yourself, didn't you?
You made this yourself, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. But Ace-san might prefer to win it herself rather than have someone give it to her...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because what Rice made isn't a real Paka-Petit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems Rice Shower wants to give something real in return.
After thinking it over for a moment, I decide to make a suggestion.
choice_data_list: Since I went through the trouble of making it, I might as well give it to them.
Let's go for it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? B-But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was made with all my heart.
Knowing Katsuragi Ace's personality, there's no way she won't love it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“...... Yeah.
I'm worried she might be disappointed, but...
Rice will try giving it to her.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for yesterday, Rice!
I put that plushie on display in my room.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Y-You put it on display...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about what's on the desk.
My racing outfit must've been really hard to make, right?
And yet it's recreated right down to the finest details...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The embroidered letters on the back
were catching the sun and shining—
it was seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll cherish it. After all, it's a one-of-a-kind, special doll made just for me by Rice!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, gotta get going.
Seriously, thanks a bunch! See ya, Rice!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: To think... she'd be this happy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I worked up my courage... and I'm so glad I handed it over...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I need to go say thank you to Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I need to go say thank you to Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... you'll help me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... will you help me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Rice Shower doll is well-made, and since
she went through the trouble of making it, I'd like her to give it over, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For now, I decided to do as Rice Shower wished.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Ace-san?
Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, you know.
Remember when I gave Rice that Paka Petit before? The one in uniform.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I thought you might want
your racing outfit instead,
so I came to fetch it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! I-I'm sorry!
Um, Rice... er... that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I calmed the panicked Rice Shower down
and gently patted her back to encourage her to explain the situation.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
Come on, you should've just told me if that's the case!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you don't need to apologize.
If anything, I'm the one who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Well then, as a thank-you...
I'll aim for Rice's Paka Petit in her racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
One good turn deserves another.
You two better cheer for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheering on Katsuragi Ace as she gave it her all,
I successfully managed to obtain the Rice Shower
Paka-Puchi plushie in her racing outfit.
